motion.name: ease-standard

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action: teal fill, white text, 12px corners, 48px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; background: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #0F766E; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #134E4A; border-color: #134E4A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #EA580C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The one warm action on a view: terracotta fill, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; background: #EA580C; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #EA580C; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #134E4A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action: transparent with a stone border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: #1C1917; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #E7E5E4; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(231, 229, 228, 0.5); border-color: #D6D3D1; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #EA580C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field: white fill, stone border, teal focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #57534E; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1C1917; border: 1px solid #E7E5E4; border-radius: 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A8A29E; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #D6D3D1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0F766E; outline: 3px solid #EA580C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface on warm sand, 1px stone border, flat with no shadow.
components.html:
الوحدة الأولى

مقدمة في المحادثة اليومية، مع تمارين قصيرة بعد كل درس.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E7E5E4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; color: #1C1917; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: #57534E; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 65ch; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Mint status pill for counts, grades, and group state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; background: #CCFBF1; color: #134E4A; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Landing navigation link with a mint hover fill.
components.html: المعلمونالدوراتالأسعار
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: #57534E; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { background: #CCFBF1; color: #134E4A; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #EA580C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Progress
components.description: Flat teal progress bar on a stone track; always paired with a label.
components.html: تقدّم المجموعة60%
components.css: .ds-progress-wrap { font-family: Cairo, Readex Pro, sans-serif; } .ds-progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #57534E; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-progress { height: 8px; background: #E7E5E4; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: #0F766E; border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview:
Emtiaz should feel like a majlis: a calm, generous room where a teacher hosts students and parents. Warm sand paper, white surfaces, and one-pixel stone borders hold the content. The interface is the furniture, not the decoration — nothing floats or glows, and state is expressed through border and color rather than shadow.

The palette carries the hospitality. Gulf teal is the host: the color of the room and of every action that moves learning forward. Terracotta is the coffee pot — a warm accent kept for the one thing that needs attention. Typography is Arabic-first: Cairo sets the voice, DM Sans is its Latin twin, and English is a mode of the same room, not a translation of it.

Density is comfortable rather than airy. Phone-first tap targets, 16px body text, and 1.65 line-height give a parent enough rhythm to scan a gradebook without instructions.
keyCharacteristics: Warm sand ground (#FAF8F5), white cards, and 1px stone borders; no shadows anywhere.
Gulf teal (#0F766E) for navigation, primary actions, links, and progress.
Terracotta (#EA580C) on no more than 10% of a screen, marking a single point of attention.
Rounded but not bubbly: 12px controls, 16–20px containers, full pills for status.
Arabic-first RTL with a mirrored English mode.
Comfortable phone density: 48px minimum controls and generous line-height.

rules.name: The One Warm Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta covers ≤10% of any screen. It marks the one thing the user should notice; using it twice dilutes it to decoration.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is a 1px stone border on warm paper. No box-shadows, glows, or glassmorphism anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Arabic-First Rule
rules.body: Start every text style in Arabic and RTL. English inherits the same sizes, weights, and line-height; it may never compress the Arabic setting to fit.

rules.name: The Two-Step Weight Rule
rules.body: Use 400 for reading and 600–700 for emphasis. No light weights; they disappear on a phone in daylight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface that needs to stand out gets a border or a tonal fill, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Concentric Corner Rule
rules.body: Never place a 12px control inside a 16px card flush to its edge; either inset it by at least 4px or reduce the inner radius so the corners read as parallel.

dos: Do place white cards on Warm Sand and separate them with 1px #E7E5E4 borders.
Do keep terracotta to one attention point per screen.
Do design Arabic and RTL first, then mirror spacing and icons for English.
Do keep every phone control at least 48px tall.
Do use 12px radii for controls and 16–20px for containers.
Do use the 3px terracotta focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients-as-depth, or glassmorphism.
Don't use terracotta as a large fill or a second primary color.
Don't set body text below 16px on mobile.
Don't substitute pure black or cool grey; Ink (#1C1917) and Stone (#E7E5E4) are warm.
Don't write English first and translate into Arabic; Arabic is the source language.
